name: Da Lat
provinceNote: Mui Ne shares Lam Dong on paper after the provincial merger. The coast is still a separate ride.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Cool air, pines, and Xuan Huong Lake in the middle of town, with strawberries on the market slope and grilled rice paper after dark. Stay for the highlands. Choose Nha Trang or Mui Ne when the sea is the trip.
fee: The lake is free. Palaces, gardens, and waterfalls ticket on their own.
getThere: Lien Khuong Airport (DLI), about 30 km south, with flights from Ha Noi and Ho Chi Minh City
seoTitle: Da Lat travel guide — lake, market, and pine ridges
seoDescription: Xuan Huong Lake sits in the middle of Da Lat, with strawberries on the market slope. Lien Khuong is about 30 km south. December to March is the dry window.
intro: The morning is mist on Xuan Huong Lake and the pines along the bank. Walk the shore, then climb the market slope for strawberries, flowers, and a cup of avocado ice cream.

Stay when the cool highlands are the trip. Choose Nha Trang or Mui Ne when the sea is the reason. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism puts both a few hours away by car. The minutes are Check on arrival. Treat each coast town as its own trip from Ho Chi Minh City.

The art-deco station, with DALAT across the yellow facade, runs a short tourist train toward Trai Mat and the mosaic pagoda at Linh Phuoc. Crazy House and Bao Dai Palace III fit between lake mornings. A clear morning is the cable car from Robin Hill up to Truc Lam, or Datanla Falls on Prenn Pass. Lang Biang is the northbound half-day.
After dark the night market grills rice paper and pours hot soy milk, and the path around the lake stays lit. The lake is free. Palaces, the waterfall, and the gardens each ticket on their own.
gettingAround: Lien Khuong Airport sits about 30 km south of town on National Highway 20, at Lien Nghia in Duc Trong. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names flights from Ha Noi and Ho Chi Minh City. Taxi minutes and the fare are Check on arrival. Vietnam Tourism Information prints the road from Ho Chi Minh City at about 293 km, and from Nha Trang at about 205 km. The minutes on those roads are Check on arrival.

In town, walk the lake, Lam Vien Square, and the market. Use Grab or a taxi for Prenn Pass, Lang Biang, and Trai Mat. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says motorbike touring is popular on the waterfall roads. Ride yourself only with the proper license. There is no passenger train into Da Lat. The station line is the tourist run to Trai Mat.

stayAreas.name: Around Xuan Huong Lake
stayAreas.summary: Walk to the market slope, Lam Vien Square, and the evening path along the water.

eat: Morning is the market slope: strawberries with condensed milk, artichoke tea to take home, and banh mi from a counter. Evening is the night market for grilled rice paper and hot soy milk. Coffee belongs to the Cau Dat hills. The food page names the dishes and the two markets.
interestsBody: Dining is market strawberries, avocado ice cream, and night-market rice paper.
The central market sells flowers and produce in the morning. Stall prices are Check on arrival.
Coffee is Arabica country on the Cau Dat hills. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names farm tours, including K'Ho.
Lakes and waterfalls are Xuan Huong in town, then Truc Lam, Datanla, and Lang Biang on half-day rides. Tuyen Lam is the reservoir south of town.
The hill-station layer is the railway station, Bao Dai Palace III, the cathedral on Tran Phu, Domaine de Marie, the education college on Yersin, and Crazy House.
Flowers are Lam Vien Square beside the lake, and the December festival displays. The city flower garden at 2 Tran Nhan Tong is a separate ticketed walk.
Cool evenings are the night market and the lit walk around Xuan Huong.

blocks.heading: Da Lat Market
paragraphs: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism describes the central market as stalls of fresh flowers and produce. The sloping halls are also where you buy strawberries. The door is free. Walk uphill from Xuan Huong Lake.

Visit Lâm Đồng does not print an address or opening hours for the market. Both are Check on arrival. Stall prices are Check on arrival. The night stalls, about 18:00–23:00 on the Visit Lâm Đồng night-market lines, are the food walk in the same centre.

cards.title: Da Lat Market
cards.summary: Morning flowers, produce, and strawberries on the slope. The door is free. Address and hours are Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Coffee hills
interestGroups.summary: Arabica on the Cau Dat hills, and a slow cup after the lake.
body: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism puts Da Lat in Arabica country and names farm tours, including K'Ho, on the hills around Cau Dat. Those names are tours. A stall price is not printed.
Drink the cup after the lake walk. Market strawberries and night-market rice paper stay with the food page.

cards.title: Coffee hills
cards.summary: Cau Dat slopes and the farm tours Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names. Drink it after the lake.

interestGroups.title: Lakes and waterfalls
interestGroups.summary: Xuan Huong is the lake in town. Truc Lam and Datanla are the southbound half-day.

blocks.heading: The lake in town
paragraphs: Wake to mist on Xuan Huong and walk the shore. Visit Lâm Đồng lists the lake as free. Bring a layer from November to January, the months Vietnam National Authority of Tourism says turn chilly.

blocks.heading: South of town
paragraphs: A clear morning is the cable car from Robin Hill to Truc Lam, with Tuyen Lam Lake below the monastery. Datanla Falls is the other southbound stop, on Prenn Pass. Lang Biang is the northbound half-day, at the tourism zone on 93A Bidoup.

cards.title: Xuan Huong Lake
cards.summary: The city lake for a walk, a pedal boat, or a cool evening loop. The shore is free.

cards.title: Truc Lam
cards.summary: Zen monastery gardens above Tuyen Lam, usually reached by the Robin Hill cable car.

cards.title: Datanla Falls
cards.summary: The cascade on Prenn Pass. The coaster and canyoning are extra.

cards.title: Robin Hill cable car
cards.summary: The line down toward Truc Lam, with the reservoir in the view.

interestGroups.title: French hill station
interestGroups.summary: The 1930s station, the last emperor’s villa, the churches, and Crazy House.

blocks.heading: Station, villa, and churches
paragraphs: The tourist railway is the art-deco run toward Trai Mat. Crazy House, at 3 Huynh Thuc Khang, and Bao Dai Palace III, at 1 Trieu Viet Vuong, fit between lake mornings. The cathedral is the tower on Tran Phu. Domaine de Marie is the pink church at 1 Ngo Quyen. The education college’s curved colonnade is the view from Yersin.

blocks.heading: The end of the line
paragraphs: Linh Phuoc is the mosaic pagoda at Trai Mat, often paired with the tourist train. It is a pagoda, not a French villa. Visit Lâm Đồng lists admission as free.

cards.title: Da Lat Railway Station
cards.summary: The 1930s station with DALAT on the facade, and the short tourist line toward Trai Mat.

cards.title: Bao Dai Palace III
cards.summary: The last emperor’s hill villa, about 2.5 km south of the centre.

cards.title: Da Lat Cathedral
cards.summary: The cathedral and bell tower on Tran Phu. It is not Domaine de Marie.

cards.title: Domaine de Marie
cards.summary: Pink church and convent gardens at 1 Ngo Quyen.

cards.title: Education College
cards.summary: Curved colonnade and bell tower on Yersin. The view is from the street.

cards.title: Crazy House
cards.summary: Dang Viet Nga’s concrete guesthouse you can walk through. Skip it if you only wanted the lake.

cards.title: Linh Phuoc
cards.summary: Mosaic pagoda at Trai Mat, often paired with the tourist train.

interestGroups.title: Flowers and gardens
interestGroups.summary: Lam Vien Square is the lakeside stage for the December flower festival.
body: The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism sets the 11th Flower Festival opening at 20:00 on 19 December 2026 at Lam Vien Square, and the closing, with the New Year programme, at 20:00 on 31 December 2026. Flower displays run about 18 December 2026 through 3 January 2027 around Xuan Huong Lake and the central parks. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism lists the festival in December of odd years.

The city flower garden is a separate walk at 2 Tran Nhan Tong. Visit Lâm Đồng’s operator-linked pages put the adult ticket near 100,000 VND and the hours near 06:30–18:00. A child band is printed near 50,000 VND.

cards.title: Lam Vien Square
cards.summary: The lakeside square, and the flower-festival stage for December 2026.

interestGroups.title: Cool-evening stroll
interestGroups.summary: When the coast is still hot, the lake path stays lit and the night market is up the slope.
body: Visit Lâm Đồng puts the night market at about 18:00–23:00. The stalls grill rice paper and pour hot soy milk. The shore of Xuan Huong is the walk after that. Bring a layer from November to January.

cards.title: Xuan Huong at dusk
cards.summary: The lake after the light drops, with lamps on the far shore.

season.label: Cool dry months
season.note: Vietnam National Authority of Tourism calls December to March dry, cool, and sunny, with wild sunflowers on the hills in late autumn. Rain gathers from May to October, and a jumper helps from November to January. In 2026 the flower festival opens at 20:00 on 19 December at Lam Vien Square and closes at 20:00 on 31 December, with displays around the lake from 18 December through 3 January.

faqs.q: Where should you sleep in Da Lat?
faqs.a: Around Xuan Huong Lake, within a walk of the market slope and Lam Vien Square. A pine ridge above the lake is the quieter alternative. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism does not name a hotel street as the one to book.
The market slope: strawberries with condensed milk, banh mi from a counter, and hot soy milk. Stall hours are Check on arrival.
The night market, about 18:00–23:00 on Visit Lâm Đồng’s lines, then the lit path around Xuan Huong Lake. It is a hill-town stroll, not a beach-bar strip.

The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism sets the 2026 opening at 20:00 on 19 December at Lam Vien Square and the closing at 20:00 on 31 December. Displays run about 18 December 2026 through 3 January 2027. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism lists the festival in December of odd years. Later dates are Check on arrival. A 2026 visitor ticket is Check on arrival.
